headline: US targets China's advanced 7nm chip production, sparking immediate evasion tactics involving South Korean partners.
summary: The United States has escalated semiconductor trade restrictions by directly targeting Hua Hong's 7nm nodes, aiming to curb China's advanced chip manufacturing capabilities. This move has prompted China to actively seek out South Korean partners to circumvent sanctions, deepening geopolitical tensions and creating significant instability for global semiconductor supply chains and international tech collaborations.
